title: California Code of Civil Procedure section 996.330 - When a surety's cancellation or withdrawal takes effect
claims: Section 996.330 provides that cancellation or withdrawal of a surety is effective at the earliest of thirty days after notice of cancellation or withdrawal is given, the date a new surety substituted for the original surety becomes effective, or the date a new bond becomes effective.
